we have an Advocate with the Father,
et ipse est propitiatio pro peccatis nostris:
And he is the propitiation for our sins.
And not only for our sins,
but also for those of the whole world.
Et in hoc scimus quoniam cognovimus eum,
And we can be sure that we have known him by this:
Whoever claims that he knows him,
and yet does not keep his commandments,
et in hoc veritas non est.
and the truth is not in him.
vere in hoc caritas Dei perfecta est:
truly in him the charity of God is perfected.
et in hoc scimus quoniam in ipso sumus.
And by this we know that we are in him.
Qui dicit se in ipso manere, debet,
Whoever declares himself to remain in him,
sicut ille ambulavit, et ipse ambulare.
ought to walk just as he himself walked.
I am not writing to you a new commandment,
which you had from the beginning.
The old commandment is the Word,
quod verum est et in ipso,
I am writing to you a new commandment,
which is the Truth in him and in you.
For the darkness has passed away,
and the true Light is now shining.
Qui dicit se in luce esse,
Whoever declares himself to be in the light,
is in the darkness even now.
Qui diligit fratrem suum, in lumine manet,
Whoever loves his brother abides in the light,
et scandalum in eo non est.
and there is no cause of offense in him.
Qui autem odit fratrem suum, in tenebris est,
But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness,
et nescit quo eat: quia tenebræ obcæcaverunt oculos ejus.
and he does not know where he is going. For the darkness has blinded his eyes.
quoniam remittuntur vobis peccata propter nomen ejus.
because your sins are forgiven for the sake of his name.
quoniam cognovistis eum, qui ab initio est.
because you have known him who is from the beginning.
adolescents, because you have overcome the evil one.
because you have known the Father.
I am writing to you, young men,
et verbum Dei manet in vobis,
and the Word of God abides in you,
and you have overcome the evil one.
Do not choose to love the world,
neque ea quæ in mundo sunt.
nor the things that are in the world.
non est caritas Patris in eo:
the charity of the Father is not in him.
quoniam omne quod est in mundo, concupiscentia carnis est,
For all that is in the world is the desire of the flesh,
and the desire of the eyes,
et superbia vitæ: quæ non est ex Patre,
and the arrogance of a life which is not of the Father,
And the world is passing away,
qui autem facit voluntatem Dei manet in æternum.
But whoever does the will of God abides unto eternity.
it is the last hour. And,
et sicut audistis quia antichristus venit,
as you have heard that the Antichrist is coming,
et nunc antichristi multi facti sunt;
so now many antichrists have arrived.
unde scimus, quia novissima hora est.
By this, we know that it is the last hour.
They went out from among us,
but they were not of us.
if they had been of us,
certainly they would have remained with us.
sed ut manifesti sint quoniam non sunt omnes ex nobis.
But in this way, it is made manifest that none of them are of us.
Sed vos unctionem habetis a Sancto,
Yet you have the anointing of the Holy One,
Non scripsi vobis quasi ignorantibus veritatem,
I have not written to you as to ones who are ignorant of the truth,
but as to ones who know the truth.
et quoniam omne mendacium ex veritate non est.
For no lie is of the truth.
nisi is qui negat quoniam Jesus est Christus?
other than he who denies that Jesus is the Christ?
Omnis qui negat Filium, nec Patrem habet:
No one who denies the Son also has the Father.
Vos quod audistis ab initio, in vobis permaneat:
As for you, let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you.
si in vobis permanserit quod audistis ab initio,
If what you have heard from the beginning remains in you, then you,
et vos in Filio et Patre manebitis.
too, shall abide in the Son and in the Father.
which he himself has promised to us:
I have written these things to you,
because of those who would seduce you.
let the Anointing that you have received from him abide in you.
Et non necesse habetis ut aliquis doceat vos:
you have no need of anyone to teach you.
sed sicut unctio ejus docet vos de omnibus,
For his Anointing teaches you about everything,
and it is not a lie.
And just as his Anointing has taught you,
et non confundamur ab eo in adventu ejus.
and we may not be confounded by him at his advent.
If you know that he is just,
that all who do what is just are born of him.
